description: Disproved physical font-width bank retained as a migration tombstone.
verification_method: The complete ROM contains no direct 0x0853E5B4 pointer word. A 256-byte extent crosses the code-verified handler-pair base at 0x53E698, and its final 28 bytes are canonical handler pointers rather than widths; the verified font tables are separately rooted at 0x53D644 and 0x53D73C. This disproves the historical physical extent without claiming an exhaustive absence of computed logical references.
notes: The proven dialogue glyph lookup remains the separate 0x53D644 chain. Legacy rom_fonts rows are diagnostic-only.
